title: Write a query and view results

blocks.content:
With the Grafana data source selected, you can write a query to generate sample data and see it displayed in your panel.

To write a query and view the results, complete the following steps:

1. In the query editor, find the **Scenario** dropdown.
2. Select **Random Walk** from the list. This generates a simulated time series that wanders up and down over time.
3. Click **Run queries** (or press Shift+Enter) to execute the query.

You should see a time series line chart appear in the visualization preview above the query editor. The chart shows the random walk data plotted over time.

4. Give your panel a title by typing a name in the **Title** field in the display options sidebar on the right.
5. Click **Save dashboard** in the top-right corner, then click **Save** in the dialog.

Your first panel is now saved to the dashboard with live data.
